story.title: Evil
paragraphs_en: Chapter 1 Evil. What does that word mean to you? After I poisoned Snow White, the whole world thought I was evil. Without any trial, they threw me in Prison. What about my side of the story? What about me? I did not struggle when they arrested and dethroned me. What was the point? I had lost everything. No one felt the agony and pain I felt.

Chapter 2 I had a first love. His name was Arthur. I came from a rich family. My mother, Cora wanted power. So, she learned magic from her friend, Gothel. My father died of sickness when I was a baby. As a young woman, I was bright. And beautiful too. So my Mother tried to marry me off to the king. I refused. As a result, I tried to run away with Arthur. My mother caught us. And she used her witchcraft to rip out Arthur's heart and crushed it, trapping him in a locket. I backed away in horror, grabbed the locket Arthur was trapped in and ran. Then everything went black.

C hapter 3 I woke up in a bedroom. Apparently, I fainted in the forest and the King fell in love with me after his old wife died when giving birth to a daughter. On one cloudy night, the King proposed to me. I agreed. I thought "With the power of queen, I might be able to get Arthur out of the locket!" I was wrong. I summoned all the greatest wizards and good witches of all the lands. None of them could get him out, but one witch, Skylena the Wise, managed to get him out of the locket and into a mirror. She also told me once a person is trapped in an object, he or she loses his memory and fades away and by putting him in a mirror. I would have more time getting it out. My heart broke. I asked Skylena to apprentice me so I could try and get him out.

Chapter 4 During my apprenticeship, Skylena taught me many things like potions and spells, but I was so heart-broken that I begged her to turn my heart into willow bark as I grew many willow trees in the palace garden. She agreed. Now, when I hold the heart, do I have any sort of emotion whatsoever. After I ended my apprenticeship, I went back to the palace. There, I found out that Arthur had begun to speak in rhyme and he could answer any question. I did not care for Snow White, daughter of the king's recently deceased wife.

Chapter 5 On that fateful day,when I asked Arthur a question about me, he responded with "Although my queen is fair to see, Snow White is indeed fairer than thee." This drove me mad with rage. I called beauticians from all over the land to preserve the youth I had left. From that day onward, I hated Snow White. When Snow White was a teenager, the king died of sickness. Leaving me with her. I ordered my huntsman to kill her and give me her heart. I also made Skylena advisor in return for her help. The huntsman fell to her beauty. I was livid. I went into my secret laboratory and dipped an apple in poison while Skylena watched me. I also drank a impersonating potion to turn me into a young peasant woman selling apples. You know what happens next.

After Snow white was woken up by the Prince I got arrested, my belongings taken away and locked in a vault. I was turned into a bird and locked in a cage that was in a cell in the dungeon surrounded by guards. Snow White was crowned queen. And she and the prince lived happily ever after. Or did they ? One day, I swear I will get out of here and have my revenge.

sentences.text_vi: Để lại tôi với cô bé.

sentences.text_vi: Tôi ra lệnh cho thợ săn của mình giết cô bé và mang trái tim cô bé về cho tôi.

sentences.text_vi: Tôi cũng phong Skylena làm cố vấn để đền đáp sự giúp đỡ của bà.

sentences.text_en: The huntsman fell to her beauty.

sentences.text_en: I was livid.
sentences.text_vi: Tôi giận tím mặt.

sentences.text_en: I went into my secret laboratory and dipped an apple in poison while Skylena watched me.
sentences.text_vi: Tôi đi vào phòng thí nghiệm bí mật của mình và nhúng một quả táo vào thuốc độc trong khi Skylena nhìn tôi.

sentences.text_en: I also drank a impersonating potion to turn me into a young peasant woman selling apples.
sentences.text_vi: Tôi cũng uống một loại thuốc giả dạng để biến mình thành một phụ nữ nông dân trẻ bán táo.

sentences.text_en: You know what happens next.
sentences.text_vi: Con biết chuyện gì xảy ra tiếp theo rồi đấy.

sentences.text_en: After Snow white was woken up by the Prince I got arrested, my belongings taken away and locked in a vault.
sentences.text_vi: Sau khi Bạch Tuyết được Hoàng tử đánh thức, tôi bị bắt, đồ đạc của tôi bị lấy đi và bị nhốt trong một hầm chứa.

sentences.text_en: I was turned into a bird and locked in a cage that was in a cell in the dungeon surrounded by guards.
sentences.text_vi: Tôi bị biến thành một con chim và bị nhốt trong một cái lồng đặt trong một xà lim ở ngục tối, xung quanh là lính gác.

sentences.text_en: Snow White was crowned queen.
sentences.text_vi: Bạch Tuyết được đội vương miện làm nữ hoàng.

sentences.text_en: And she and the prince lived happily ever after.
sentences.text_vi: Và cô ấy cùng hoàng tử sống hạnh phúc mãi mãi về sau.

sentences.text_en: Or did they ?
sentences.text_vi: Hay là không?

sentences.text_en: One day, I swear I will get out of here and have my revenge.
sentences.text_vi: Một ngày nào đó, tôi thề sẽ thoát ra khỏi đây và trả thù.
